- **Builder:** DOD Electronics
- **Pedal:** YJM 308 Overdrive Preamp
- **Catalog type:** Overdrive
- **Research level:** Deep
- **Deep research status:** Verified identity and signature relationship
- **Identity basis:** DOD's preserved product-manual index explicitly lists the YJM 308 Overdrive Preamp, and DOD's historical reconciliation identifies it as a signature overdrive/preamp associated with Yngwie Malmsteen.

The **DOD YJM 308 Overdrive Preamp** is a historical signature DOD overdrive/preamp. The exact model designation is preserved in DOD's official manual archive. [1]

DOD's historical reconciliation keeps the YJM 308 in the **Overdrive** category and separately notes its signature relationship. The signature relationship is part of the product identity, not a reason to create a second dirt category. [2]

The archive preserves the **YJM 308** name rather than collapsing it into the general DOD 250 family. A signature model can share circuit lineage with other DOD designs while remaining a distinct catalog identity when DOD gives it a distinct product name and model number.

No claim is made here that every YJM 308 unit is electrically identical to every version of the DOD 250 or another DOD overdrive without unit-specific documentation.

A complete model-specific factory schematic/BOM, production revision chronology, and universal component inventory were not established in this pass. The archive therefore leaves transistor, clipping-device, and op-amp fields unresolved rather than borrowing them from related DOD models.

The YJM 308 belongs to the historical DOD overdrive/preamp line preserved in the company's product-manual archive. The official index continues to carry the model alongside other legacy DOD FX-series products. [1]

- **Archive photo:** No verified local photo is currently archived for the YJM 308.
- External collector and marketplace imagery remains separate from archive-local photo coverage.
